newsitem.title: LATVIA: INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT UP 7.7 PCT IN MAY YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT UP 7.7 PCT IN MAY YR/YR.

text.p: Latvian industrial production rose in comparative prices by 7.7 percent in May versus May of 1996, the statistics committee said on Friday.
In real prices, industrial output in May totalled 119.5 million lats, the committee said in a statement.
However, the committee said that compared with April, industrial output was down by 6.6 percent.

On an annual basis, output in the quarry and extraction sector rose by 13.8 percent, in the processing sector the rise was 8.9 percent and the increase in the electrical energy, gas and water sector was 1.4 percent.
The largest rise between May 1997 and May 1996 was in the cellulose and paper industry, where output was up 90.6 percent, and the metalworking sector, up 45.7 percent.
Output fell in the automobile and trailer sector, down 84.9 percent and the leatherwork and clothing sector fell 65.8 percent.
